description: A neutral example naming standard: kind-area-purpose, with an optional environment at the end.

segments.name: kind
segments.description: What the object is: SG group, AU administrative unit, CAT catalog, AP access package, POL assignment policy, AR access review.

segments.name: area
segments.description: The part of the organization the object belongs to.

segments.name: purpose
segments.description: What the object is for, written in PascalCase.

segments.name: environment
segments.description: Optional: Prod or Test. A name may leave it out.
